ability-score-improvement.gist: +2 to one ability score or +1 to two, to a maximum of 20

alert.gist: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative and swap Initiative with a willing ally

archery.gist: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons

boon-of-combat-prowess.gist: +1 to one ability score (max 30); once per round, turn a miss into a hit

boon-of-dimensional-travel.gist: +1 to one ability score (max 30); teleport 30 ft after the Attack or Magic action

boon-of-fate.gist: +1 to one ability score (max 30); add or subtract 2d4 on a d20 Test within 60 ft

boon-of-irresistible-offense.gist: +1 Str or Dex (max 30); your Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing damage ignores Resistance

boon-of-spell-recall.gist: +1 Int, Wis or Cha (max 30); a level 1-4 slot isn't spent if 1d4 equals its level

boon-of-the-night-spirit.gist: +1 to one ability score (max 30); in Dim Light or Darkness: Invisible and Resistance

boon-of-truesight.gist: +1 to one ability score (max 30); Truesight out to 60 feet

defense.gist: +1 to Armor Class while you wear armor

grappler.gist: +1 Str or Dex; hit and grapple with one Unarmed Strike; Advantage vs creatures you grapple

great-weapon-fighting.gist: Treat 1s and 2s on damage dice as 3s with two-handed Melee weapons

magic-initiate-cleric.gist: Learn two Cleric cantrips and a level 1 spell, cast free once per Long Rest

magic-initiate-druid.gist: Learn two Druid cantrips and a level 1 spell, cast free once per Long Rest

magic-initiate-wizard.gist: Learn two Wizard cantrips and a level 1 spell, cast free once per Long Rest

savage-attacker.gist: Once per turn, roll a weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll

skilled.gist: Proficiency in any three skills or tools; repeatable

two-weapon-fighting.gist: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the Light weapon extra attack
